• Brand introduction: We are a brand orginally based for the film industry. Our industry has a habit of charging 3x of what items should be just becasue they can.  I created this brand to make quality prodcuts for the price that they should be. Our first few products are storage solutions. We have started using the storage bags for a lot of stuff around the house, including toys, tools and more.
• Product description: We sell storage bags that are unique becasue of the useage of velcro to label. The bags are very high quailty and can be used for so many things.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): Super high quailty but priced right. Label storage and high quailty see through. 
• Payment terms: net 30 with 10 percent return on sales
